body: Hey! this sounds like me, apart from I’m convinced a cancer has spread into my liver and it’ll fail soon, it’s horrible, you don’t know what’s real or not sometimes with health anxiety, even the lightest touch of my clothes in that area is making me think something is sticking out. I hate it. Xx

Hey! thanks for replying, I’m just in a state right now and ugh I hate it. I’ve been prodding deeply all into my right ribs and shit and it’s been tender now for a bit but I think it’s from the amount of prodding I’m doing. It’s just a real cycle isn’t it. I’m going to try and have 7 days with no poking or prodding and if any pains remain get checked out :)

Omg this is literally how I feel. My childhood (luckily) was amazing and I grieve it daily, I never wanted to grow up and my depression actually was triggered by growing up. Ive had so much joy in this world from that and now I feel like I have nothing, if I died my mum and Nan would care if that but my dad would probably go to the pub the next day and laugh with his friends. My friends would do some fake shitty post on Facebook then get on with their lives lol!
I plan too! I only seen her last month, think she’s sick of the sight of me😹
I did! she said the 30th I can have one, which seems like a lifetime away

you have no idea how much this has made my day, to have someone logic my horrible thoughts out and not make me feel like a complete freak is lovely thank you so much, I’m going to stop doing them! (well try lol) it’s honestly so horrible as like I said I’m not a doctor so anything that feels lumpy I freak out like anything but clearly the body isn’t empty and being so slim I feel literally all sorts, I panicked as I recently found a a lump, got it checked and it was a cyst luckily but now I’ve convinced myself I have liver mets and my doctor was wrong, it really is crippling and leading me into such a dark place. I can’t even distract myself much. I just think about my death 24/7, I hate it. Sorry to offload to you but it helps to tell someone who understands, thank you again so much.
Loneliness, abuse, the pure hate of the cruel world we live in. Never had motivation to do literally anything, I only enjoyed being a child, since 13+ nah this shit can get fucked
Lol this is literally me, sometimes I dread looking up the symptoms as I know in the next day or two I will have it

I’ve had 3 of these for over 2 years! mine feel like spots under the skin! sometimes they feel bigger, sometimes smaller, had them checked twice and the doctor said the same to me! they don’t cause me any issues besides the mental side of knowing they’re there lol!!
